subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Penetration Testing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Penetration Testing usable.

hook.text: A company hires a team to break into their own system. Within hours, they have admin access.

buildup.text: Penetration testing simulates real attacks to find vulnerabilities before malicious actors do.

discovery.text: Testers follow a structured approach: reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation, and reporting.

twist.text: Finding the vulnerability isn't enough. The report must show business impact so leaders prioritize fixes.

climax.text: The pen test report lists 8 critical findings. All are fixed before the next release ships.

punchline.text: Pay testers to break in. It's cheaper than letting attackers do it.
